steps.name: DESeq2 differential expression: aldosterone vs vehicle
steps.question: Which genes are differentially expressed between aldosterone-treated and vehicle kidney samples (6 vs 6), and what are their shrunken log2 fold changes and adjusted p-values?

grounding.reason: DESeq2 Wald test with apeglm shrinkage, explicit reference level, BH+independent filtering per R-0029/R-0002/R-0026/R-0036/R-0001/R-0039/R-0009/R-0083/R-0010/R-0043

steps.description: On the raw counts.csv (12000 genes x 12 samples after dropping the gene-symbol column as rownames) and metadata.csv (condition column), build a DESeqDataSet with design ~condition, set the explicit reference level to the vehicle/control group, pre-filter to genes with at least 10 counts in at least 6 samples (the smallest group size), run DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization and the Wald test for the contrast condition aldosterone vs vehicle, apply apeglm shrinkage to the log2 fold change, and extract results with BH adjustment and independent filtering at alpha=0.05. Report the MA plot and the dispersion plot as fit diagnostics, the p-value histogram before adjustment, the number of genes tested after filtering, the number of DE genes at padj<0.05, and any genes flagged NA by the Cook's-distance outlier rule (6 replicates per group is below the 7-replicate threshold where DESeq2 flags rather than replaces outliers).
acceptance_criteria: DESeqDataSet built with design ~condition and reference level explicitly set to vehicle/control
Pre-filter keeps genes with >=10 counts in >=6 samples
Wald test run with apeglm-shrunken log2FoldChange reported alongside the unshrunken estimate and lfcSE
BH-adjusted p-values (padj) reported with independent filtering on, alpha=0.05
Full results table (gene, baseMean, log2FoldChange, shrunken log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj) exported for downstream enrichment/TF steps
MA plot, dispersion plot, and pre-adjustment p-value histogram produced
Number of genes tested, number of DE genes at padj<0.05, and any Cook's-distance-flagged NA genes reported

steps.description: Rank all genes tested in the DESeq2 contrast by the Wald statistic (stat column) and run fgsea preranked GSEA against the MSigDB Hallmark human gene sets (50 sets, 2026.1 release) with min/max set sizes 15-500 after intersecting with the tested genes; then repeat against the Reactome human pathways and WikiPathways human pathways as follow-up collections. Hallmark, Reactome, and WikiPathways run and reported as three separate tables with each collection's version stated
Gene sets restricted to 15-500 members after intersection with tested genes
BH-adjusted enrichment p-values reported; redundant/overlapping sets collapsed with one representative per group
Leading-edge genes listed for each significant set

steps.name: Transcription factor activity inference (decoupleR ulm, CollecTRI)
steps.question: Which transcription factors show the strongest inferred activity change (increased or decreased) between aldosterone-treated and vehicle kidney samples, based on the CollecTRI regulon network and the DE contrast statistic?

grounding.reason: TF activity from a 6-vs-6 contrast: decoupleR ulm on the contrast statistic with the CollecTRI prior network (a self-inferred network is unsound at this sample size, per R-0121)

steps.description: Using the Wald statistic of every gene tested in the aldosterone-vs-vehicle DESeq2 contrast as the input activity signature, run decoupleR's univariate linear model (ulm) against the CollecTRI human TF-target regulon network (source/target/weight columns, signed edges kept so a repressor target lowers the inferred activity). Require at least 5 of a regulator's targets among the tested genes to include that TF. Report the ranked table of TF activity scores (normalized enrichment / t-values) with BH-adjusted p-values, state the number of regulators tested, and list the top 6 TFs by |activity| in each direction (up-regulated activity under aldosterone, down-regulated activity under aldosterone) to match the requested six-per-group framing.
acceptance_criteria: decoupleR ulm run on the full Wald-statistic vector of tested genes (not the significant subset alone) against the CollecTRI human regulon network
Signed regulon edges (activator/repressor mode) preserved in the model
Regulators with fewer than 5 targets among tested genes excluded, and the number of regulators tested reported
Ranked TF activity table with score and BH-adjusted p-value produced
Top 6 TFs with increased inferred activity and top 6 with decreased inferred activity under aldosterone explicitly listed

steps.name: Integrated report: DE genes, pathways, and TF drivers
steps.question: What is the integrated picture of which genes change with aldosterone treatment and which transcription factors plausibly drive those changes?

grounding.reason: Report synthesis step: no single method rule applies, but reporting-content rules (R-0041, R-0051, R-0085, R-0086, R-0105) are grounded and followed

steps.description: Compile a single report combining: (1) the six-per-group framing requested — top 6 upregulated and top 6 downregulated genes by shrunken log2FoldChange among padj<0.05 DE genes, with baseMean, log2FC, lfcSE, padj; (2) the top 6 TFs with increased and top 6 with decreased inferred activity from the decoupleR/CollecTRI step, cross-referenced against which of their known targets appear among the DE genes; (3) the Hallmark/Reactome/WikiPathways enrichment summary as pathway-level context. State package versions, DESeq2 design and contrast (aldosterone vs vehicle, vehicle as reference), thresholds (padj<0.05, BH), number of genes tested vs DE, the QC findings from T1S1, the enrichment collection versions, the CollecTRI regulon count, and full session info / seed for reproducibility. Explicitly note the n=6-per-group DESeq2 outlier-flagging caveat and that TF activity is a prior-network inference, not a direct measurement of TF binding or protein activity.
acceptance_criteria: Top 6 up- and top 6 down-regulated DE genes listed with effect sizes and adjusted p-values
Top 6 up- and top 6 down-activity TFs listed with their scores and adjusted p-values
DE genes cross-referenced against top TF regulons where overlap exists
Pathway enrichment summarized across all three collections with versions stated
Full reproducibility record (package versions, seed, collection versions, design/contrast, thresholds, n tested vs n DE) included
Caveats on outlier-flagging at n=6 and on TF activity being an inference from a generic prior network (not tissue-specific) stated explicitly

plan.title: Aldosterone vs vehicle kidney: DE genes and TF activity
plan.analytical_narrative: 12 kidney samples (6 aldosterone-treated, 6 vehicle) with raw Salmon gene-level counts. The plan follows the grounded DESeq2 workflow: sample-structure QC, minimal pre-filter, DESeq2 Wald test with an explicit reference level (control) and apeglm shrinkage, BH-FDR with independent filtering to call the differentially expressed genes, then two downstream readouts of the same contrast statistic — fgsea preranked enrichment (Hallmark, then Reactome and WikiPathways as follow-up collections) and decoupleR ulm transcription-factor activity inference on the CollecTRI human regulon network — and a final integrated report tying the DE gene list to the TF calls that plausibly drive them. All reference collections needed (MSigDB Hallmark human, Reactome pathways, WikiPathways human, CollecTRI human regulons) are confirmed present in the reference store; org.Hs.eg.db is present for identifier mapping. No batch structure exists in this single-batch, unpaired, 6-vs-6 design, so no batch term is modeled.

steps.method: Keep genes with >=10 counts in >=6 samples (smallest group size)
DESeq2 design ~condition, explicit reference level = control
Benjamini-Hochberg FDR with independent filtering, alpha=0.05
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome and WikiPathways
decoupleR ulm on CollecTRI regulons using the Wald statistic
Integrated DE + enrichment + TF activity report
